coverage_gap=No runtime reproducer, KASAN build, or per-driver audit was produced to prove that non-linear skbs actually reach ieee80211_rx_h_data(), ieee80211_invoke_fast_rx() or ppp_ccp_peek() in any concrete s03 configuration; non-linearity was assessed structurally.
limitation=All three findings are source-reading hypotheses, not reproductions: each requires a non-linear skb so that __pskb_pull_tail actually reallocates and frees the old head, and exploit impact (crash/infoleak vs. controlled disclosure) was not assessed.
limitation=The ppp_ccp_peek finding needs a PPP channel that hands up a non-linear skb plus, for the decomp_init/comp_init leg, negotiated compression state (SC_CCP_OPEN|SC_CCP_UP); only the CCP_OPT_LENGTH(dp) stale read at 3157 needs the peer ConfAck itself.
limitation=Line numbers for ieee80211_invoke_fast_rx come from scanner offsets anchored to a verified dump of net/mac80211/rx.c lines 5000-5120 and may be off by 1-2 lines; the reported 100-line range 5010-5109 covers save, pull and stale use.
limitation=The seed code net/phonet/pep.c pep_get_sb() (lines 46-67) is present and still unpatched in s03 but was excluded from reporting by assignment.
